sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Legal Accounting Defense for International Anti-Dumping Inquiries

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English common law and French civil law systems with residual customary law)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations (PACER Plus) — in force for Vanuatu; contains trade liberalization and investment cooperation provisions
Pacific Island Countries Trade Agreement (PICTA) — preferential trade agreement among Pacific Forum members
Melanesian Spearhead Group (MSG) Trade Agreement — economic cooperation framework with Fiji, Papua New Guinea and Solomon Islands
Tax Information Exchange Agreement (TIEA) framework with Australia and New Zealand — relevant for cross-border ownership and tax due diligence
No comprehensive bilateral investment treaty with major capital-exporting states is currently in force

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [Cap. 222], as consolidated (including the 2010 and 2011 amendments); Financial Services Commission Act No. 4 of 1998; Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 36 of 2018; Money Laundering (Prescribed Transactions) Regulations 2009; Beneficial Ownership Regulations enforced by the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit under the AML/CFT Act.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of the passport of each ultimate beneficial owner and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the document holder's country of origin and the relevant Ministry of Foreign Affairs
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization by a Vanuatu High Commission or Embassy (Vanuatu is not a party to the Hague Apostille Convention)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified proof of residential address for each ultimate beneficial owner and director (bank statement or utility bill issued within the last 90 days)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing regulated bank or utility company, then notarized by a notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization by Vanuatu diplomatic mission

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation and certificate of incumbency, where a corporate body is a shareholder of the new International Company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies Registry in the corporate shareholder's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization by Vanuatu diplomatic mission (Hague Apostille accepted only by reciprocal registrar-agent practice for Apostille-member states)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter covering the beneficial owner, acceptable signatories and intended banking relationship
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Correspondent or commercial bank where the beneficial owner maintains a banking relationship
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization at the issuing bank and consular legalization where required by the registered agent

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All ultimate beneficial owners, directors, secretaries and authorized signatories are screened before incorporation and at onboarding against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, US OFAC SDN List, UK Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation list, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and the domestic Vanuatu sanctions and terrorist-listing notices. PEP status and adverse media findings trigger enhanced due diligence and senior management approval. Biometric passport verification is encouraged. Screening results are recorded in the AML/CFT compliance file and refreshed at 180-day intervals for the life of the relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — Company Search and Name Reservation online portal (https://www.vfsc.vu)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Statutory names must be expressed in Latin script. English and French names satisfying the VFSC clarity standard are accepted; foreign-language names must be transliterated into Latin characters and accompanied by a certified English or French translation. An International Company must include an acceptable liability suffix such as 'Limited', 'Ltd.', or a French-equivalent expression.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name rejection may be appealed in writing to the Registrar of International Companies within 21 days of the rejection notice, together with the prescribed appeal fee and a legal memorandum addressing the stated objection. The Registrar must issue a written determination within 15 working days. If the appeal is dismissed, the applicant may file judicial review proceedings in the Supreme Court of Vanuatu. A rejected name is generally unavailable for re-reservation for 60 days; the applicant should tender one amended name per review cycle.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible for an International Company in the trade-remedy defense consultancy sector. The company must maintain a physical registered office in Vanuatu at the address of a licensed registered agent. A virtual office or post-office box alone does not satisfy the International Companies Act or the licensing standard for professional-services activity.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 35% within the first three full reporting years. Unannounced on-site inspections are conducted by the VFSC and the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit; prior written notice is normally given except where suspected AML/CFT violations warrant immediate inspection.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: VFSC name search and name reservation fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the VFSC fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: International Company incorporation filing fee (standard authorized share capital)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the International Companies Act fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: First-year annual license fee for trade-remedy defense consulting activity
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff for regulated professional-services activity

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed registered agent and registered office service for the first year
UBO identification, AML/CFT client file preparation, PEP and sanctions screening
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Compliance service provider / licensed registered agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for compliance onboarding

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and consular legalization of beneficial owner documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public and Vanuatu diplomatic/consular mission
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official tariff plus prevailing market rate for consular legalization

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified corporate document package in English (certificate of incorporation, company seal, share certificates, statutory registers)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap. 222] of Vanuatu (Revised Edition 2020), Sections 5 (Incorporation), 9 (Memorandum and Articles of Association), 10 (Company Name), 16 (Registered Office and Registered Agent), and 21 (Board of Directors)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – Companies Registry, International Companies Division, Government Buildings, Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form IC-1 Application for Incorporation of an International Company, together with the Memorandum and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital requirement; authorized share capital may be denominated in any freely convertible currency; shares may be subscribed without any mandatory escrow deposit; a VFSC-licensed registered agent is required but no statutory escrow trust account is imposed on a standard International Company
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Memorandum and Articles of Association filed with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission are hereby adopted. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office be established at the VFSC-approved registered agent's address in Port Vila, and that the registered agent be appointed. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the subscribers hereby appoint the following individuals as directors of the Company, to serve until successors are elected. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the directors are authorized to issue shares, to appoint officers, to open bank accounts, and to enter into engagements for anti-dumping trade-defense consulting; and RESOLVED FURTHER, that all actions taken prior to this resolution are ratified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Companies Registry – online filing portal at www.vfsc.vu
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit three proposed names in order of preference using Form IC-2 Name Reservation Request; the Registry verifies availability against the International Companies Register and prohibits names identical or deceptively similar to an existing company or a prohibited name under Section 10; the approved name is reserved for 90 days.
required_dossiers: Statement of intended business scope (ISIC 7490 trade-remedy defense consulting)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected, file a fresh reservation with amended alternatives or request written reasons from the Registrar; a refusal may be judicially reviewed before the Supreme Court of Vanuatu.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Constitutional Instruments
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-licensed Registered Agent and a Notary Public admitted in Vanuatu
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in the English language; the subscriber executes the Memorandum in the presence of the registered agent or a notary; the first directors execute Consents to Act; ensure the registered agent's address appears as the Company's registered office.
required_dossiers: Consent to Act of each first director
Individual subscriber details (full name, nationality, residential address)
Certified passport copies and proof of address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If notarization or attestation is deficient, cure by re-executing before a licensed Vanuatu notary or the registered agent; any forged or incomplete consent is corrected by a substitute director consent accompanied by a statutory declaration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Incorporation Application to VFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Registry, International Companies Division
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form IC-1 Application for Incorporation with the executed Memorandum and Articles, registered agent consent, and name reservation certificate; pay the statutory filing fee of USD 350 via SWIFT wire transfer to the VFSC government account; obtain the stamped receipt as proof of filing.
required_dossiers: Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Registered Agent consent and appointment letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry issues a requisition, respond within 14 calendar days with amended documents or a cure notice; an application rejected for formal defects may be refiled with corrected instruments without loss of priority where the name reservation remains valid.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Register Entry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Registry, International Companies Division
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon satisfactory review, the Registrar stamps the Memorandum and Articles, assigns a unique International Company registration number, enters the Company in the International Companies Register, and issues the Certificate of Incorporation dated as of the registration day.
required_dossiers: Approved Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate contains typographical errors or an incorrect registration date, file a rectification application supported by an affidavit; the Registrar has statutory power to correct the register and re-issue a certificate nunc pro tunc.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Governance and Bank Account Activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-licensed Registered Agent and a licensed Vanuatu commercial bank (e.g., ANZ Vanuatu or Bred Bank) with SWIFT/Wire capabilities
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting, adopt the pro-forma First Board Resolution, issue share certificates to subscribers, appoint officers, approve the registered agent agreement, and open a corporate multi-currency account supporting SWIFT and wire transfer payment rails for trade-remedy defense fee collection.
required_dossiers: Bank account opening forms and KYC/beneficial ownership declarations
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank queries KYC or beneficial ownership documentation, supply an additional corporate register extract and a sworn declaration of ultimate beneficial owner; any governance omission is cured by a unanimous written shareholder resolution or a subsequent board ratification.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – International Companies Division; Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA) for Foreign Investment Certificate matters
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: International Company Certificate of Incorporation and, where applicable, Foreign Investment Certificate authorizing international trade-remedy defense consulting (ISIC 7490)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change, Republic of Vanuatu
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – Administrative Office Use Only; no industrial processing, manufacturing, or physical works triggering a Full EIA Report or Environmental Registration
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable to a professional consulting office; no wastewater discharge, VOC emissions, or hazardous waste streams; municipal solid waste segregation and standard commercial waste collection guidelines under the Waste Management and Pollution Control Act [Cap. 283] apply.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from the Vanuatu Fire and Rescue Service following an inspection of office premises; structural load clearance from the Public Works Department confirming the occupancy class is suitable for professional office use; workplace health and safety clearance under the Health and Safety at Work Act [Cap. 246] covering emergency exits, first aid, and electrical safety.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Authority (VRCA), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; official portal: https://www.vrca.gov.vu. Company registration and International Company (IC) licensing: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), https://www.vfsc.vu.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1 - Incorporate the International Company (IC) with VFSC and obtain the Certificate of Incorporation and a licensed registered agent; the VFSC registration number is the entity's primary statutory identifier because Vanuatu levies no income tax. Step 2 - If the IC makes (or voluntarily elects to make) taxable supplies in Vanuatu, submit the VAT Registration Application (Form VAT-01) to VRCA with certified copy of the Certificate of Incorporation, memorandum and articles, registered agent consent, director and beneficial-owner identification, and expected turnover estimate; VRCA issues a Tax Identification Number (TIN) and VAT Registration Certificate, typically within 10 business days. Step 3 - If the IC imports or exports physical goods, obtain an Importer/Exporter Code from the VRCA Customs Division (ASYCUDA World platform). Step 4 - For the pure offshore consulting model (ISIC 7490 trade-remedy defense), no VAT registration or TIN is required because the IC is statutorily tax-exempt and its export services are zero-rated; the entity must maintain the VFSC annual return and pay the flat annual government fee to remain in good standing.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone - International Companies are exempt from all Vanuatu taxes (income, corporate, withholding, capital gains, stamp duty, and estate taxes) under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222], as amended. The IC sits outside the VAT net when it carries on no taxable activity inside Vanuatu; export services supplied to non-residents are zero-rated if registration is required or elected.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vanuatu has no direct taxation, so no check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch elections exist. Available statutory elections: (1) voluntary VAT registration under Section 7 of the VAT Act No. 12 of 1998 for persons below the VUV 5,000,000 threshold; (2) continuation or redomiciliation of a foreign company as an International Company, or conversion of an IC into a domestic company under the Companies Act, by directors' or members' resolution lodged with VFSC; (3) the Minister of Finance may grant additional tax exemption certificates to VFSC-licensed offshore entities by order. No CFC, dividend, interest, or royalty elections apply because Vanuatu does not tax such flows.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the VAT Act No. 12 of 1998, as amended; separate customs and excise duties are administered by VRCA; no GST or sales-and-use tax exists.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 5,000,000 (five million vatu) annual taxable turnover; registration is mandatory once actual or expected turnover in any 12-month period exceeds the threshold and voluntary below it; ICs supplying services entirely offshore are not carrying on a taxable activity and are not registrable.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, e-invoicing API, or digital stamping mandate exists in Vanuatu as of the current regime. VAT-registered suppliers must issue a prescribed tax invoice within 28 days of supply and retain records for 5 years. VRCA operates electronic return filing and the ASYCUDA World customs platform, but individual invoices are not cleared or stamped by the revenue authority.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Under Section 9 of the VAT Act, goods qualify for zero-rating when exported and delivered outside Vanuatu within 28 days; services qualify when supplied to a recipient who is not in Vanuatu and the services are performed (or the benefit is enjoyed) wholly outside Vanuatu. ISIC 7490 anti-dumping and trade-remedy defense consulting qualifies when the foreign client is the recipient, the defense work is executed offshore, and the output is used exclusively in foreign administrative or judicial proceedings. The supplier must hold contemporaneous service, delivery, and remittance evidence. Vanuatu has no exchange-control repatriation statute; the 180-day inward-remittance evidence window is the standardized bank and AML substantiation benchmark used in the zero-rating refund file.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (goods) or Export Service Contract and engagement letter (services)
Bill of Lading or air waybill (goods) or service delivery and utilization report with foreign proceeding reference (services)
Inward Remittance Certificate - SWIFT MT103 credit advice (services) or foreign currency bank statement
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: VRCA may deny or claw back zero-rating, issue a default assessment at 12.5% on the full supply value, and recover interest at 10% per annum where export, service, and remittance evidence is missing or false. Fixed monetary penalties apply per offence for invoicing, registration, and return failures; wilful evasion or fraudulent refund claims are criminal offences punishable by significant fines and/or imprisonment. Retrospective assessment periods generally extend up to 5 years, and up to 7 years in cases of fraud or wilful misstatement.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vanuatu vatu (VUV) is freely convertible on both current and capital account. Vanuatu maintains a liberal exchange control regime; non-residents and International Companies may hold VUV and foreign currency accounts without prior RBV approval. Profit remittance, dividend distribution, loan servicing, and capital repatriation are not subject to exchange control licensing or ad-hoc administrative barriers. Payments for imports, professional services, and trade settlements are unrestricted. The only practical frictions arise from correspondent bank compliance and the limited depth of the onshore FX interbank market, which is predominantly quoted in VUV/USD, VUV/AUD, VUV/NZD, and VUV/EUR.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Vanuatu imposes no statutory surrender requirement on export receipts. There are no mandatory conversion ratios, no designated time limits for repatriation, and no RBV requirement to convert foreign currency earnings into vatu. Exporters and consulting firms may retain overseas currency in licensed dealer bank accounts indefinitely, subject to standard AML/CFT record-keeping obligations under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific (BSP) Vanuatu Limited

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. Vanuatu has no domestic Electronic Money Institution (EMI) licensing framework; only banks and financial institutions licensed under the Banking Act may accept deposits or provide payment services in vatu. Offshore digital EMIs are not recognized as local deposit-taking institutions and cannot directly clear VUV. They may be used as auxiliary FX conversion or wallet providers for USD/Euro flows, but the core cross-border treasury operation must anchor to a licensed Vanuatu dealer bank to maintain legal payment rails and correspondent settlement.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For a VFSC-registered International Company, physical attendance is not statutorily required, but bank policy varies. ANZ and BSP permit remote onboarding using certified true copies, video KYC, and electronic signing where the account is non-lending and meets enhanced due diligence criteria. National Bank of Vanuatu and smaller institutions generally require at least one director or authorized signatory to attend a face-to-face interview in Port Vila or Luganville. Therefore, remote opening is feasible for tier-1 banks if the full corporate registry dossier is apostilled/legalized and supported by a VFSC-issued certificate of incumbency.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ambiguous beneficial ownership arising from an International Company with nominee shareholders or bearer shares
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide VFSC certificate of incumbency, registered agent declaration, full chain of ownership from nominees to underlying natural persons, trust deed or declaration of trust, sworn source of wealth statement, and bank references from prior licensed counsel.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade-remedy defense consulting perceived as legal practice requiring a local law license
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Supply ISIC 7490 scope explanation, engagement letters describing anti-dumping inquiry defense, case docket references, and evidence of foreign bar admission or in-house counsel authority; confirm that no local legal advice is rendered in Vanuatu.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume cross-border wire receipts from unrelated parties without clear commercial logic
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide finalized anti-dumping claim notice, defense service agreements, itemized invoices, signed work acceptance, payment schedule, and a treasury audit trail demonstrating reconciliation between client engagements and incoming wire purpose codes.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-exempt status misinterpreted as a vehicle for illegal tax evasion, undermining the bank's AML risk appetite
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Attach International Company Registration Certificate, VFSC tax exemption letter, OECD/Global Forum transparency status, a legal opinion confirming permissible tax-planning use, and a detailed explanation of the business purpose in trade-defense work.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injections must be routed by SWIFT MT103 from the originating counsel or client trust account to the VU_IC operational account at a licensed Vanuatu dealer bank. The beneficiary account must exactly match the International Company registered name. Recommended ISO 20022 purpose codes are LEGA (legal services) or ARPU (accounts receivable) for anti-dumping defense fees, and CENL (capital in enterprise) for shareholder capital injections. The sending bank must include the invoice or engagement letter reference in the payment narrative to satisfy the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit and the receiving bank's AML review. RBV requires no prior approval, but the bank must record the economic purpose.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade disbursements for settlements and litigation-related payments are executed through SWIFT MT103 for low-value remittances and via irrevocable commercial letters of credit subject to UCP600 for high-value disbursements with documentary proof. Vanuatu dealer banks rely on ANZ and BSP correspondent networks in Australia, New Zealand, and the United States; direct CHIPS or Fedwire membership is not available. For anti-dumping defense fees payable to foreign legal teams, MT103 wires with purpose code LEGA are the standard clearing rail. For settlements or custom bonds involving freight, Commercial LC, standby LC, or bank guarantee mechanisms are permissible under Vanuatu banking practice.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore VUV/USD outright forward contracts with licensed Vanuatu dealer banks
Cross-currency swaps between VUV and USD/AUD/NZD with the same or corresponding dealer banks

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) denominated in USD with offshore financial counterparties, provided the underlying commercial exposure and end-user exemption are documented and no onshore VUV delivery is made

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: International Company Annual Government Fee Renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – International Companies Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On each incorporation anniversary; renewal processing permitted within a 30-day grace period; after expiry, penalties accrue.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment surcharge of 10% per annum on the outstanding annual fee; if the fee remains unpaid for 90 days after the anniversary, VFSC may administratively strike the company off the International Companies Register and declare the company dissolved.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Business Licence Renewal (if physically operating or rendering onshore services in Vanuatu)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority / Municipal Business Licence Office with jurisdiction over the place of operations
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Business licences expire on 31 December of each calendar year; renewal application and payment must be submitted by 31 January of the following year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Operating without a renewed business licence renders the Company liable to a fine of up to VT 25,000 (approximately USD 220) and possible daily penalties; continuing operations without a licence also exposes officers to personal liability.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None. A Vanuatu International Company is exempt from statutory audit and from filing financial statements with VFSC or tax authorities, notwithstanding the level of revenue, assets, number of shareholders, or ownership nationality.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No statutory accounting framework is imposed on International Companies; where financial statements are voluntarily prepared or required by a third-party contract, International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as adopted by the Vanuatu Institute of Chartered Accountants is the recognized standard.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No annual UBO return is required to be filed with VFSC. The licensed registered agent is obligated to maintain a beneficial ownership register at the registered office and to record any share transfer or change of beneficial ownership contemporaneously. As part of each annual renewal, the registered agent certifies that the statutory registers, including the UBO register, are maintained in accordance with the International Companies Act and the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 600 – USD 1,200 per year for a licensed Vanuatu registered agent and registered office service, inclusive of the annual government fee.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: No compulsory audit is required; voluntary accountant review or financial statement preparation for creditor or regulatory reliance is typically USD 1,200 – USD 2,500 per year.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax, no capital gains tax and no payroll tax. An International Company (IC) is a Tax-Exempt Zone vehicle under the International Companies Act Cap. 222; business profits derived from outside Vanuatu, including ISIC 7490 trade-remedy defense consultancy, are wholly outside the domestic fiscal base. No statutory tax holidays or preferential deductions apply because no income tax statute is triggered. The only statutory charges are the fixed annual government registration fee payable through the registered agent and, where the IC physically carries on licensed advisory activity from Vanuatu, the annual Business License fee. No tax-loss carryforward mechanism exists because there is no income tax base; the legislative carryforward limit is therefore zero years.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: IC Annual Return (VFSC Form IC/AR, filed by the licensed registered agent through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) International Company Registry online e-filing portal)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 30 days following each anniversary of the date of incorporation (the annual return date); the Registrar issues default notices after 60 days of delinquency.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name and IC registration number of the International Company.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors/owners identify the entity exactly as shown on the Certificate of Registration; no local tax reference number is required because no income tax exists.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office address in Vanuatu maintained care of a VFSC-licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A physical Vanuatu registered office is mandatory; a P.O. Box alone is insufficient and will cause rejection of the annual return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered agent name, license number, address and contact details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The agent is the statutory interface for the IC; non-resident principals must ensure the agent holds current AML/CFT obligations for the IC's wire-based client flows.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Current register of directors, shareholders and share allocation, with true beneficial ownership declaration.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Nominee directorship must be supported by a written beneficial ownership statement to the agent; false declaration of beneficial ownership is an offense.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Principal activity declaration and confirmation that business is conducted outside Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For ISIC 7490 anti-dumping defense consulting, declare that services are rendered offshore and that no Vanuatu-source income is derived; no corporate income tax return exists to file.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Annual government fee remittance and Business License status confirmation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm Business License renewal if any part of the advisory activity is physically performed in Vanuatu; purely offshore billings via Swift/Wire remain outside the license fee bands.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts statutory late fees accruing monthly, a default penalty issued by the Registrar, and deregistration (strike-off) if the annual return remains outstanding after formal notice. Striking-off terminates the company's separate legal personality, exposing directors to transaction liabilities and reinstatement costs.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Business License Renewal (VFSC Online Business License Portal, Vanuatu Business License Act)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Renewal required by the license anniversary date; new applications ordinarily processed within 5-10 business days; renewal grace period is defined by the license term issued.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Business activity description in ISIC/NAICS alignment.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use 'Trade Remedy Defense Consulting — ISIC 7490' and avoid terminology implying locally licensed legal practice unless a Vanuatu practicing certificate is held.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Principal place of business and physical premises in Vanuatu, if any.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident licensees may declare the registered agent's address as service address; no employee presence is required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Responsible manager identification (passport copy) and contact information.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The responsible manager may be a non-resident; AML records of the managerial controller must be retained by the registered agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Estimated gross turnover band of services rendered in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Offshore-only anti-dumping advisory revenue from non-resident clients is not attributed to the Vanuatu license fee band; turnover outside Vanuatu is disregarded.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Trading without a license or after expiry of a renewal grace period attracts monetary fines, a daily continuing penalty, a cease-and-desist order, and cancellation of the IC's registry good standing.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Vanuatu levies no dividend withholding tax; distributions, dividends and capital reductions paid by an International Company to non-resident shareholders are wholly exempt from domestic tax.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no comprehensive double taxation agreement network of general application, so no domestic DTA relief form or Tax Residency Certificate protocol is engaged for IC distributions. A certificate of good standing, or on request a fiscal residence certificate, may be obtained through the registered agent from the VFSC/Ministry of Finance within approximately 5-10 business days solely for foreign counterparties seeking reduced withholding treatment in their own jurisdictions. Such certificates carry no Vanuatu tax benefit and do not create income tax liability for the IC.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory withholding on both outbound and inbound royalties and debt interest. Vanuatu does not tax IP royalty payments or loan interest paid by an IC; treaty rates are not applicable owing to the absence of DTAs. Lenders and IP licensors must therefore rely on their home jurisdiction treatment of Vanuatu-source (nil) income.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable in Vanuatu: no corporate income tax, no transfer pricing statute, and no Local File/Master File thresholds exist in vatu (VUV). If the IC belongs to a foreign group, the group's parent jurisdiction rules (commonly OECD Action 13 standards, e.g., a USD 1,000,000-plus related-party turnover threshold) determine whether a Master/Local File must be prepared abroad; the IC itself has no domestic filing obligation.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: No standalone Economic Substance Regulations have been enacted for International Companies; however, the International Companies Act requires a registered office, licensed registered agent and an annual return, and commercial substance expectations are imposed indirectly by VFSC AML supervision and by foreign CFC/economic-substance rules. For ISIC 7490 anti-dumping defense consulting, the IC must demonstrably manage, staff and execute the consulting engagements from a genuine base (typically the foreign client markets) and avoid being characterized as a letterbox holding or sham conduit in foreign tax or trade-remedy investigations. Vanuatu remains subject to ongoing OECD Global Forum and EU good-governance monitoring, which strengthens the need for documentary evidence of real activity.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly issuing or procuring false invoices, misclassifying taxable Vanuatu-source advisory services as exempt supplies, or concealing local turnover derived from domestic trade-defense meetings, expert testimony or document preparation performed in Vanuatu, in order to evade value-added tax and misrepresent the IC's exempt status.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines under the Value Added Tax Act combined with the Vanuatu Criminal Code, confiscation of proceeds, a stop-trading order, revocation of the IC's business license and strike-off from the International Company Registry.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false VAT or activity declarations are personally liable for evaded duty and penalties; the Supreme Court may issue travel bans, asset-freeze orders and disqualification orders preventing management of VFSC-registered entities, with custodial sentences attached to fraudulent evasion.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Abuse of International Company Tax-Exempt Regime / Shell Company Conduct
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the IC as a bare nominee shell: conducting the substance of anti-dumping legal defense work in Vanuatu or through local staff while falsely declaring pure non-resident exemption, or using the IC as a conduit to conceal true beneficial ownership in responses to foreign anti-dumping and trade-defense authorities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Deregistration and loss of limited liability under the International Companies Act; registry monetary penalties; in importing jurisdictions, civil false-certification penalties, customs trade-remedy evasion penalties and retroactive duty assessments attach to the foreign group entities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Vanuatu Courts pierce the corporate veil where the IC is a facade; directors face civil restitution for registry costs and third-party losses, personal liability for foreign anti-dumping evasion judgments, plus extradition and travel-ban exposure in the jurisdiction conducting the trade-remedy investigation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Unlicensed Legal Practice / Business License Deficiency
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Holding out to clients as providing legal advocacy, counsel representation or legal opinion in anti-dumping proceedings without admission under the Legal Practitioners Act, or operating trade-defense defense consulting without the required annual VFSC Business License.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Strict-liability fines under the Legal Practitioners Act and Business License Act, closure of Vanuatu operations, nullification of fee recovery for unlicensed engagements, and revocation of the registered agent's capability to service the IC.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The principal consultant and each directing mind face personal fines, disqualification from holding regulatory approvals, adverse immigration consequences, and personal judgments for refund of client fees paid into the unlicensed practice.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Anti-Money Laundering / Countering Financing of Terrorism Breach
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to conduct customer due diligence, failing to file Suspicious Transaction Reports with the VFSC Financial Intelligence Unit, accepting Swift/wire funds from clients implicated in circumvention of anti-dumping or anti-circumvention measures, or allowing the IC to be used to layer proceeds of trade fraud.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: AML/CFT Act penalties: substantial corporate fines, personal fines for directors and the registered agent, imprisonment up to 15 years, forced deregistration, and freezing of the IC's bank accounts; the agent's license is suspended or revoked.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Nominated and shadow directors face criminal liability, personal fines, confiscation of personal assets, travel bans pending investigation, and permanent disqualification from any financial or trustee role in Vanuatu.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: False Filings and Misrepresentation to the Registrar
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Submitting a materially false IC annual return — including misstated directors, false beneficial-ownership declarations, dummy registered-office arrangements, or straw-agent documentation — to conceal the real control structure engaged in international anti-dumping defense engagements.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Imprisonment and/or fine under the International Companies Act, mandatory deregistration, and loss of the benefits of limited liability for all transactions entered into during the period of concealment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the authorized signatory are personally liable for the fine and for civil restitution to defrauded counterparties; the Registrar may apply for a travel ban and for judicial orders requiring personal re-registration costs before any new Vanuatu vehicle may be incorporated.
